payload.title: 24/7 Emergency Plumber, Salt Lake City
payload.description: Plumbing emergency in Salt Lake City? Copper Eagle Plumbing takes calls 24/7. See what an after-hours visit and diagnostics cost before you call.

image.alt: Full moon in a night sky above silhouetted trees

reassurance.heading: Has disaster struck in the middle of the night?
reassurance.lead: Call us 24/7, and we’ll help solve your plumbing emergency, even if it’s in the middle of the night.
reassurance.body: We present an upfront after hours price to show up to your job, and usually a quote a typical amount* that is our normal rate for the job you are calling about. *A typical amount is an educated guess, and exact pricing is subject to change once we arrive and have a better idea of what it will take to accomplish the job.

what-to-expect.eyebrow: For your after-hours plumbing services in Salt Lake City
what-to-expect.heading: What to Expect
what-to-expect.body: We offer fair and honest upfront pricing for typical charges on our 24/7 plumbing services.

image.alt: Milky Way over silhouetted pine trees at night

factors.label: After-Hours Service Fee
factors.description: Our plumbers love thier family time as you can imagine. After a full days work we will continue our day for you and your family.  Typically $150 flat rate to come out after hours. Special hollidays are $300

factors.label: Plumbing Diagnostics
factors.description: We charge $178 to walk through and Diagnose what is going wrong with your plumbing emergency and why it’s happening.

factors.label: Extended Diagnostics
factors.description: When a problem requires additional tools beyond the basic diagnostics, we charge $278 to gain further knowledge of the problem.

factors.label: Upfront Pricing
factors.description: We work on an upfront flat rate.  We have a book that has all of our standard prices. We show you priving before we start. No surprises here!

final-response.heading: Let us help solve your after-hours plumbing emergency so you can get back to bed.

social_image.alt: Full moon in a night sky above silhouetted trees
